scientific_integrity: Self-contained universal proof; finite diagnostics are supplementary and do not establish priority or certify the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: The formula assumes the base alphabet meets its negative only at zero and has a finite nonzero zero-run maximum. It does not cover modulus two or arbitrary opposite-symbol bases. The earlier first-difference result was inspected; historical priority of the broader higher-lag formula remains subject to independent review.
title: Universal finite palindrome profiles in non-self-opposite modular-difference lifts
